endorsements.name: Nate Rotschafer, MCP
endorsements.label: N Stage Biometric Authentication
endorsements.description: The topic will be about using biometric authentication as part of a multiple stage authentication mechanism. This discussion will explore various applications and flaws with the technology along with some of my ongoing research into a replay attack on the devices by capturing what "goes down the wire".
